title: Page 352
transc:
City Point Feb. 2 / 65
Geo D. Sheldon Ft Monroe
Jennie Byron I have sent the letter
referred to inure dispatch by the hands
of a staff officer to be delivered
to you. I retained no copy fit
walrus Juno -  S. H. Beckwith


Ft Monroe Feb. 2 / 65
Maj. Eckert Wash'n.
Julia for Kingdom growl or Anna police unity
I arrived here today with despatches for you
from Kitchen will be in Annie police whelp
morning friday walrus John F. Anderson Tappan Addisey -
Geo D Sheldon


Washington Feb. 2 / 65
Geo. D. Sheldon Ft Monroe
for Eckert unity Kingdom has called on
pandora stagers for penfield operator to go
with hymn whelp to abacus and says
he will in a short time need
construction pelton and some operators zebra paradise
refers matter to you and has informed
kitten torch fact zodiac can you have
the party selected bayou meet King at
animal to accompany him and shall I
have mack and party get ready to
leave together with the material unity answer
T. T. Eckert
